verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents a built-in AI agent, Phoenix Intelligence, that inspects traces, iterates prompts and runs experiments. LLM-as-a-judge evaluations also return AI-generated explanations by default, so the product does produce AI insights from the user's own data inside the product. However, the agent appears only as a single llms.txt line, with no detail on what insights or suggestions it surfaces. The MCP endpoint serves external clients and is not credited here. Missing for 10: dedicated Phoenix Intelligence documentation describing its insights and suggestion behavior, UI walkthroughs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Hand investigations to Phoenix Intelligence, the built-in AI agent that inspects traces, iterates prompts, and runs experiments
Built-in Explanations — all Phoenix LLM evaluations return explanations by default for better results and richer signals
Every evaluation execution captures the input data, the exact prompts sent to the judge LLM, the model's full reasoning, the final scores, and execution timing.
